A '''warehouse''' was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Lower Industrial Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was heavily patrolled by Imperial [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial warehouse appears as part of the Lower Industrial Sector on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
